note: The healed student with its learned routers picking 16 of the 64 routed experts instead of 9, on section 18's GSM8K checks (slim_opd.py check with eval.experts 16), written 2026-11-01 before the run. The user: 'should we just switch from 9 experts to 16 and see if that fixes a bunch?' No training: the adapter and routers are the healing run's, trained at 9, so this is a lower bound for a model healed at 16. Local GPU (LOCAL_GPU.md), no pod; the counts are compared with the pods' (section 18), not token by token. The multiple-choice benchmark at 16 and 32 is in slim_bench_k_rules.json.

sampling.source: Qwen3.5-9B model card, thinking mode for general tasks (as opd_long_rules.json)

design: Local GPU, through dibs. The healed student is rebuilt and must reproduce the healing run at 9 experts (KL within 0.01 of 0.612). Then its learned routers pick 16 experts (4,224 of 12,288 MLP neurons per layer, 34%; about 3.4B parameters per token against 2.95B), its drift is measured again, and it answers section 18's 96 GSM8K check prompts with a 4,096-token cap, greedy and then sampled with the model card's settings and section 18's seeds. Each arm is also counted as a 2,048-token run would have ended (truncated: an answer starts the same at any cap, 96 of 96 on the pods), to compare with section 17's healed model at 2,048 (greedy 36 loops of 96).
reading: 'Fixes a bunch' if, at 16 experts and 4,096 tokens, greedy loops fall to 10 or fewer (the dense model: 7; the distilled 25% model: 27), and sampled it gets at least 60 right (healed at 9: 48; every neuron: 64; dense: 73). Partly if it clearly improves on one but misses the other. Not if greedy loops stay above 20. With the benchmark at 16 (slim_bench_k_rules.json), this decides whether the next healing run should be at 16 experts: a model healed at 16 would do at least this well, at about 3.4B parameters per token.

predictions.reproduce: The healed student reproduces the healing run's last milestone: KL within 0.01 of 0.612.
predictions.drift: At 16 experts, the benchmark KL is 0.40 to 0.52 (9 experts: 0.612; perfect router at 9: 0.517; every neuron: 0.242).
predictions.greedy: Greedy at 4,096 tokens, 5 to 20 of 96 loop.
predictions.greedy_2048: Counted at 2,048 tokens, at most 18 loop (the healed model at 9 experts: 36).
predictions.sampled: Sampled, it finishes at least 85 of 96 and gets 52 to 68 right.
